purpose: Editable policy for deciding which old/new judgments may feed runtime. Preservation is independent from adjudication.
core_principles: Never delete losing evidence solely because it lost adjudication.
Separate artifact-precedence questions from scientific/technical claim questions.
A newer timestamp is not scientific evidence by itself.
Historical/engineering facts use source quality, comparable conditions, physical constraints, reproducibility and uncertainty.
Scenario-policy choices use explicit scenario authority and provenance, not scientific scoring pretending to be physics.
Downstream battle outcomes may not be used to prove upstream technical capability unless an explicit learning/feedback edge exists.
Unresolved material conflicts block only the affected runtime field, not the entire corpus.

score_dimensions.description: primary measurement/documentation > well-traced secondary > unsourced narrative
same weight/altitude/load/date/configuration/definition is required for direct comparison
mass, power, drag, heat, material, endurance, geometry and conservation constraints
inputs, formula/logic and uncertainty are inspectable
sister-unit/lot/multiple-test repeatability; median preferred over exceptional best case
invention, testing, adoption, production, training and unit-median clocks are not collapsed
independent evidence supports the same band/direction

decision_thresholds.close_margin: 0-4 -> preserve both and use bounded/gated state
decision_thresholds.fatal_physics_conflict: automatic reject for runtime until repaired

technical_adjudication.uncertainty_rule: Prefer a justified interval over a forced point estimate.

precedence: explicit later correction/handoff specific to the claim
dedicated scenario canon with explicit overwrite
scenario_adjudication.note: This precedence decides scenario intent, not external scientific truth.

status_semantics.accepted: may feed runtime directly within valid scope/date
status_semantics.high_confidence_provisional: may feed bounded runtime; retain uncertainty band and audit pointer
status_semantics.provisional_center: usable for sensitivity/centerline if event handout explicitly marks provisional
status_semantics.conditional: usable only when listed host/fielding/clock conditions are satisfied
status_semantics.gated: do not feed runtime until gate closes
status_semantics.diagnostic_only: comparison prior/check only; never an input multiplier
status_semantics.rejected_for_runtime: preserve as history/evidence but do not feed calculations
